text: Now for some science that'll blow your mind Jamie. Researchers have cracked the code on turning plastic waste into clean hydrogen fuel using nothing but sunlight.

speaker: alice
text: This is huge Alex! We're talking about solving two massive problems at once - plastic pollution and clean energy production. Imagine all that plastic waste sitting in landfills getting transformed into fuel for our future.
